variants.HistGB_log1p: Keep B's 13 input fields and HistGB parameters; fit log1p(target), invert with expm1. Diagnostic of cross-room target scale and large-error weighting; not an unbiased original-scale mean estimator.
variants.HistGB_absolute: Keep B inputs and parameters except loss=absolute_error. Diagnostic of squared-error sensitivity and mean-vs-median objectives.
variants.HistGB_add_floor_WFR: Keep B inputs and squared-error HistGB; add Floor_0based and WFR_window_to_floor. Diagnostic of available but previously omitted BIM representations.
variants.HistGB_without_obstruction: Keep B inputs except Solar_Obstruction_Ratio; diagnostic of reliance on an annual scalar obstruction proxy.
variants.ExtraTrees_B: Same B inputs, ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=100,max_depth=12,min_samples_leaf=100,max_features=1.0,n_jobs=4,random_state=2026). Algorithm sensitivity comparison, not hyperparameter search.

cv: All five variants use the same seven leave-one-room-out TRAIN folds, both targets: 70 fits. Original B HistGB is a frozen reference, not retrained.
known_room_diagnostic: For BM223 P10 and BM522 mean illuminance, train separate HistGB models on that room's months other than 3/6/9/12, evaluate those four complete months with all angles held together. Compare to original unseen-room predictions on exactly those timestamps. This measures known-room temporal prediction, not new-room generalization.
data_checks: Original source hash and frozen model predictions
Per-room target scale, P10/mean ratio and sensor density
counterfactuals: For the two focus folds, vary supplied static features while keeping held-out weather/time/angle fixed; compare frozen-model predictions after substituting each training room's static input template. These are model-sensitivity diagnostics, not physical interventions or deployment predictions.
modeling_limits: No TEST predictions, scores or target distributions
Diagnostics selected after observing development CV failures; improvements on these folds remain exploratory
Raw sensor-grid illuminance and original geometry are unavailable, so CSV checks cannot establish correct P10 export or room-to-sensor mapping
EPW provenance, time convention and model-to-geographic-north mapping remain unconfirmed
